description: This PHP source file defines the vardefs (variable definitions) for the 'TemplateSectionLine' module in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM project. It sets up the database table name, audit settings, inline editing, duplication checks, and the fields with their properties such as 'thumbnail', 'grp', and 'ord'. It also includes a conditional require statement for the SugarObjects VardefManager class, which is used to create the vardef entries for the module.

classes.name: VardefManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing variable definitions (vardefs) in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It is included via require_once and used to create vardefs for the module.

methods.name: createVardef
methods.description: A static method of VardefManager that creates the vardef entries for a specified module, including the list of behaviors such as 'basic'.
